scripts.dev: concurrently "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w client"
scripts.dev:open: concurrently --kill-others-on-fail "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w client" "npx wait-on http://127.0.0.1:3000 && xdg-open http://127.0.0.1:3000" "npx wait-on http://127.0.0.1:5001/api/health/status && xdg-open http://127.0.0.1:5001/api/health/status"
scripts.start:prod: NODE_ENV=production npm run build:client && npm run start:server
scripts.test: npm test -w client && npm test -w server
scripts.verify: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run build:client && npm test
